label: oci-adapter-distinct-port-shape
content: The corelink-adapter-oci adapter's ports differ from the other adapters: trait `BlobStore` (not CasStore), `ManifestKvStore` (not KvStore), `TenantResolver::resolve_pat(&SecretWrap)`, and uses `PortResult<T> = Result<T, String>` plus `bytes::Bytes`.
quote: oci uses `PortResult<T> = Result<T, String>`, `bytes::Bytes`, `SecretWrap`, completely different shape

content: Per the Wave-34 charter (parallel-safe per Section 0.6), each per-package-manager adapter in corelink-server (cargo/npm/brew/oci/pip) declares its own minimal port surface inline rather than depending on a shared port crate.

label: kvbridge-wire-format-ts-prefix
content: In corelink-server's corelink-adapter-host, the NpmKvBridge and PipKvBridge wire format stores `inserted_at_unix_ms` as an 8-byte big-endian prefix before the value bytes; the pip bridge encoding matches the npm bridge encoding exactly.
